 What is Common Room 
 Common Room is a customer intelligence platform built for mid-market and enterprise GTM teams — sales, marketing, revenue operations, community, and DevRel — who need to find and act on high-intent buying signals at scale. Rather than relying on a single data source like website traffic or a static contact database, Common Room aggregates signals from 50+ channels simultaneously: website visits, product usage, job changes, LinkedIn activity, GitHub and developer community activity, G2 reviews, Slack communities, and more. These signals are unified through an AI-powered identity resolution engine that stitches together fragmented data points across channels into a single, actionable view of each prospect — even when they're anonymous across different touchpoints. 
 The platform's flagship AI capability is RoomieAI™, an AI agent that automatically hunts for warm leads across all connected signal sources, surfaces the highest-intent prospects, resolves their identities, enriches their contact data, and can trigger automated outbound plays — email sequences, CRM tasks, Slack alerts — without requiring manual review of every signal. This positions Common Room not just as a signal aggregation tool, but as an AI-driven prospecting and pipeline acceleration engine. Customers including Grammarly report outcomes such as 30% more meetings per rep and 74% pipeline growth within a single quarter of deployment, driven by the ability to prioritize outreach around warm, intent-rich signals rather than cold outbound.
